title: Person: Merge
description: Merges `secondary` into `primary`, then deletes `secondary`. The operation is not reversible, and `primary` must already exist. See [merging duplicate people](/journeys/people/manage/merge-people/).

type.description: The operation modifies a person in Customer.io

action.description: Merges `secondary` into `primary`, then deletes `secondary`. Not reversible; see [merging duplicate people](/journeys/people/manage/merge-people/).

primary.description: The person who remains after the merge, identified by `id`, `email`, or `cio_id`. If email identifiers are disabled in [workspace settings](https://fly.customer.io/workspaces/last/settings/edit), use `id` or `cio_id`.

secondary.description: The person deleted after the merge, identified by `id`, `email`, or `cio_id`. If email identifiers are disabled in [workspace settings](https://fly.customer.io/workspaces/last/settings/edit), use `id` or `cio_id`.

cio_id.description: A unique identifier set by Customer.io, used to reference a person if you want to update their identifiers.

not_nullable_customer_id.description: The ID of a customer profile, analogous to a "person" in the UI.

not_nullable_email_address.description: The email address of the customer.
